attention4.ptxt: Bumper surface where the remaining parts in the body such as muffler tail pipes may interfere could be scratched if the surface is not protected with masking tape etc.
Apply masking tape for protection of the surface against the scratch.

s1.ptxt: Stick masking tapes (1) for protection of bumper surface.
Remove bolts, screws and clips, and then release fittings of bumper from body.
Disconnect license plate light connectors, rearview camera connector and rear bumper wire.
Disconnect rear fog light connector, if equipped.
For parking sensor model, disconnect parking sensor connector.

attention3.ptxt: Remove rear bumper pulling it backward and downward so that the bumper does not bump against the tail pipes.

servinfosub.title: Installation
servinfosub.ptxt: Reverse removal procedure noting the following point.

item.ptxt: When installing new rear bumper, protect the surface sticking masking tape.
